definitions.explanation: The state of being strong, active, and full of energy.

examples.japanese: {活力|かつりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちている→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧。
⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{活力|かつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: To give energy to the economy.

examples.japanese: {活力|かつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。

notes:
{活力|かつりょく} means vitality, energy, or vigor.

WRITING:
⟦{活|かつ}→活：noentry⟧ (life, active) + ⟦{力|りょく}→力：01661_chikara⟧ (power)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {活力|かつりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: full of vitality
- {活力|かつりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have energy
- {活力|かつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose vitality
- {活力|かつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧: to regain vitality
- {活力|かつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give energy

USAGE:
- Personal health/energy
- Economic vitality (⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{活力|かつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)
- Organizational energy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧: health, cheerfulness (casual)
- ⟦{精力|せいりょく}→精力：05526_seiryoku⟧: energy, stamina
- ⟦{気力|きりょく}→気力：08515_kiryoku⟧: willpower, spirit
